question: Hoc phi tai UET la bao nhieu?
expected_answer: Hoc phi duoc quy dinh theo so tin chi va tung chuong trinh dao tao.

question: Sinh vien co the xem quy dinh hoc phi o dau?
expected_answer: Trong tai lieu quy dinh hoc phi va so tay hoc vu cua nha truong.

question: Dang ky hoc phan nhu the nao?
expected_answer: Sinh vien dang ky hoc phan qua he thong theo lich hoc ky va huong dan cua phong dao tao.

question: Neu dang ky hoc lai hoac hoc cai thien diem thi can lam gi?
expected_answer: Can xem cac muc ve hoc lai va hoc cai thien diem trong tai lieu dang ky hoc phan.

question: Hoc bong UET co nhung dieu kien nao?
expected_answer: Sinh vien can dap ung tieu chuan hoc tap va cac dieu kien xet hoc bong theo thong bao.

question: Thanh phan ho so xin hoc bong gom gi?
expected_answer: Thuong gom don dang ky, bang diem, bai luan, thu gioi thieu va minh chung thanh tich.

question: Ky tuc xa UET co quy dinh gi?
expected_answer: Sinh vien can xem quy dinh ve cho o, ho so va cac dieu kien su dung ky tuc xa.

question: Sinh vien co duoc ho tro cho o o gan truong khong?
expected_answer: Tai lieu neu co cac hinh thuc ho tro cho o va huong dan lien he phu hop.

question: UET co thong bao gi ve hoc bong Vallet?
expected_answer: Co thong bao xet chon hoc bong Vallet danh cho sinh vien UET.

question: Thong bao ho tro Tet Nguyen Dan noi gi?
expected_answer: Co thong bao ho tro cho nguoi hoc nhan dip Tet Nguyen Dan.

question: UET Job Fair 2026 duoc thong bao nhu the nao?
expected_answer: Co thong bao trieu tap sinh vien tham du su kien UET Job Fair 2026.

question: Tin tuc ve hop tac tai UET noi gi?
expected_answer: Co thong bao ve tin tuc hop tac giua truong va doi tac ngoai truong.

question: Lam sao tra hoc phi?
expected_answer: Sinh vien can tra hoc phi dung han va theo huong dan thanh toan cua nha truong.

question: Sinh vien can xem thong tin dang ky hoc phan o dau?
expected_answer: Thong tin dang ky hoc phan nam trong so tay hoc vu va huong dan cua truong.

question: Tai lieu nao noi ve hoc bong va hoc phi?
expected_answer: Hai nhom tai lieu chinh la hoc bong va hoc phi trong thu muc legal.
